title: Freeze Manifest
description: Verifiable manifest for a frozen core: artifact digests, honest labeling, and provenance. Normative field semantics live in docs/SPEC.md.

manifest_version.description: Version of the manifest format itself.

id.description: Stable identifier of the core, e.g. 'ara-core'.

labeling.description: Honest labeling block. Fields may be null/empty, but the gate degrades the verdict to WARN when required labels are missing.

base_model.description: What this core is built on, stated plainly.

modifications.description: Every modification applied to the base. An empty array is an explicit claim of 'none'.

parent_core.description: id@version of the core this freeze derives from; null for a root freeze.

frozen_by.description: Who performed the freeze. Null leaves the freeze unattributed (gate WARN).

artifacts.description: Every file in the frozen core, with its digest. The manifest itself is never listed.

path.description: POSIX-style path relative to the core root.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the file contents.

bytes.description: File size in bytes at freeze time.
